source_claim: MAP-Elites is a quality-diversity search/archive approach that motivates maintaining coverage across descriptor-defined niches alongside quality. The public opportunity map cites it as a starting point, not proof of superiority or of trading-signal performance on OpenForage.
hypothesis: In paired runs under one fixed era/config and equal completed-evaluator budgets, a bounded policy that targets the least-covered publicly enumerable construction source × measured-depth descriptor will increase distinct valid observed descriptor breadth versus uniform random_weighted, while keeping local quality-pass/lifetime-yield within a noninferiority margin fixed before results. Failure to improve breadth or exceeding that margin falsifies the direction. Claim feature × rotation coverage only if public analytics actually exposes it; otherwise leave exact feature attribution and breadth unknown.
